mapper.select: SELECT p.*, p.user_id AS userId, p.reject_reason AS rejectReason, u.nickname AS nickName, u.avatar FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status != 4
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET view_count = #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET comment_count = GREATEST(0, comment_count - 1) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = GREATEST(0, like_count - 1) WHERE id = #{id}
